market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. September seasonality, US-Iran conflict, rising rates, and Canada trade war create headwinds. Expect 3-5% index pullback potential. Energy and defense outperform; tech faces volatility. Bond yields likely to rise further on hyperscaler issuance. Diesel at all-time high pressures consumer margins.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle intact with hardware leadership; defense spending structural; EM rotation offers relative value. However, rate environment and geopolitical fragmentation cap upside. Favor quality, cash-flow-generative names over speculative growth. 10-year hold candidates in AI infrastructure and defense tech.
